summary.headline: Ashiana Housing Q1 FY27 revenue fell to INR107 crores from INR293 crores as handovers slipped; management reiterates INR2,200 crores FY27 presales target.
summary.overview: Q1 FY27 bookings were INR358 crores across 234 units (3.6 lakh sq ft), down from the strong prior quarter, while collections rose 6% YoY to INR409 crores. Average realisation rose 37% YoY to INR9,923 per sq ft on product mix. Reported revenue was INR107 crores, driven by Phase 1 handover at Ashiana Nitara, Jaipur; management attributed the shortfall to handover timing, with OC for Anmol Phase 3 and Amarah Phase 1 (about INR532 crores of revenue) arriving mid-July and shifting into Q2. The company bought 28.55 acres at Vadgaon, Maval, Pune, its largest Senior Living land deal (about 20 lakh sq ft, potential sales value around INR1,800 crores).

segments.name: Senior Living
segments.commentary: About 23% of the business per management, up from about 10% five to six years ago. Presales were about INR570 crores last year; management targets about INR1,500 crores by FY29-30 and about 25% CAGR long term. Five projects are deployed, and the company aims for about INR10,000 crores GDV in Senior Living.

segments.name: Regular housing (Gurugram, Jaipur, Bhiwadi)
segments.commentary: Management flagged a near-term lack of inventory to sell in these key markets, which is expected to dampen presales in the next year or two. Ashiana Aaroham Phase 3 (Gurugram) is the big H2 launch.

segments.name: Elite and Premium homes
segments.commentary: Ongoing portfolio mix at 36%, per the analyst's figure. Management said the mix shift is toward Senior Living, not a pivot to premium homes.

guidance_outlook: FY27 presales target of about INR2,200 crores, which management says is on track; July 2026 cumulative sales were about INR859 crores.
Expected H1 FY27 presales exit of about INR1,050-1,100 crores by 30 September 2026.
FY27 reported revenue indication of about INR2,000 crores.
Target ROE floor of 15% on a long-term basis; management expects about 20% ROE in FY27 on a reported basis.
FY27 deployment budget of about INR800 crores for new land and deals, including about INR180 crores deployed in Q1.
Vadgaon (Pune) underwriting: about 20 lakh sq ft, INR9,000-10,000 per sq ft realisation, around 2 lakh sq ft sold per year, launch in H2 of next financial year.
capex_capacity: Vadgaon, Maval, Pune: 28.55 acres acquired in Q1 FY27 for about 20 lakh sq ft saleable area, about 10-year development at base case (about 7 years at 3 lakh sq ft per year). Funded through a debenture structure with landowners holding 25% of purchase value and a 6% revenue share.
Ashiana Aaroham Phase 3 (Gurugram) launch expected in Q3 or Q4 FY27.
Bengaluru (Kanakapura Road) Senior Living project: documentation pending; two team members deployed to prepare launch.
Ashiana Nitara Phase 1 (Jaipur) handover commenced in Q1 FY27.
Business development active in Jamshedpur (small deal expected soon), Chennai, Mumbai, Pune and NCR; further Bengaluru transactions targeted for Q3 FY27.
demand_pricing: Management described residential demand as softer in the quarter on global uncertainty and wait-and-watch buyers, with prices resilient across most markets.
Senior Living is seen as insulated from cyclicality; management says organised supply is limited.
Sales-and-marketing costs fall as a location matures: Ashiana Shubham (Chennai) fell from about 8% to 4-5% of sales.
Gurugram resale control: management says resale stock should not exceed about 20% of Amarah Phase 1, versus 80-90% trading at peers.
Anmol Phase 3 and Amarah Phase 1 gross margins are in the mid-20s blended; Amarah Phase 3 onward margins are expected to be substantially better.

qa_highlights.question: What drives H2 bookings and confidence in FY27 guidance after a soft Q1?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said July 2026 sales beat all of Q1; cumulative FY27 sales were about INR859 crores by 31 July. The big H2 launch is Aaroham Phase 3 (Gurugram) in Q3 or Q4, and H1 is expected to exit at INR1,050-1,100 crores.

qa_highlights.question: Sustainable presales trajectory over 3-5 years?
qa_highlights.answer: Management expects a dip in presales for a year or two due to thin inventory in Gurugram, Jaipur and Bhiwadi, with recovery in FY28-29 or FY29-30. Capital is shifting to Senior Living, with a target of about INR1,500 crores of Senior Living presales by FY29-30.

qa_highlights.question: Why ROE expectations changed from 20%+ to 15%?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said 15% has been the long-term goal and was reached on a reported basis last year. It expects about 20% in FY27 and says 15% should be the floor. The margin framework is about 30% gross, 12% SG&A, 18% PBT and 12-13% PAT margin, which should give teens ROE and about 20% with further improvement.

qa_highlights.question: Why was Q1 revenue so low, and is it a steady-state run rate?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said Q1 was not normal. Anmol Phase 3 and Amarah Phase 1 OCs came in mid-July, so about INR532 crores of revenue shifts into Q2. Management asked investors to judge on a year-on-year basis and pointed to the FY27 revenue indication of about INR2,000 crores.

qa_highlights.question: Units sold fell from 407 to 234 YoY. Deliberate or volume slowdown?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it was not entirely deliberate, citing lower inventory in some markets. It pointed to the July launch and reiterated the INR2,200 crores presales target.

qa_highlights.question: Vadgaon payback and underwriting?
qa_highlights.answer: Underwriting assumes INR9,000-10,000 per sq ft on 20 lakh sq ft, or INR1,800-2,000 crores of revenue. Sales are planned at about 2 lakh sq ft per year, with a launch in about 18 months. The NCD was issued by the landowners, who keep a 25% stake plus a 6% revenue share.

qa_highlights.question: Capex for the deals in pipeline and IFC partnership status?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the FY27 deployment budget is about INR800 crores, including Q1 deals and deals in active discussion. The IFC platform is exhausted or lapsed because of ticket-size caps. There is no active agreement, though discussions on future capital are ongoing.

risks_watch: Revenue timing risk: about INR532 crores from Anmol Phase 3 and Amarah Phase 1 shifts into Q2 on mid-July OCs; management says quarterly revenue and profit are not a reliable guide.
Presales delivery: H1 FY27 exit of INR1,050-1,100 crores must come through, and the INR2,200 crores full-year target relies on the Aaroham Phase 3 (Gurugram) launch in Q3 or Q4 FY27.
Inventory gap: management expects a dip in presales for a year or two from thin inventory in Gurugram, Jaipur and Bhiwadi, and has not given a quantified floor.
ROE framing: management moved from 'about 20%+' to a 15% floor and a teens ROE on the margin framework; monitor reported ROE against the 20% FY27 expectation.
Bengaluru (Kanakapura Road) Senior Living documentation is still pending; the Q3 FY27 timeline for further Bengaluru and other BD deals is not yet firm.
IFC platform has lapsed for further deals, so future capital needs for the INR800 crores deployment budget rest on internal accruals or new partners.

summary.management_tone: Management was confident on the FY27 INR2,200 crores presales target and the INR1,050-1,100 crores H1 exit, citing July sales and the Q3/Q4 Aaroham Phase 3 launch. It was cautious and somewhat defensive on the soft Q1 revenue and units sold, calling Q1 "not normal", and on the ROE framing, where it shifted to a 15% floor.
